components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary call-to-action — Start Extraction, Confirm, Save
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d4a843; color: #161616; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 18px; font-family: "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e0b85a; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #b89230; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #282828; color: #888888; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action — Browse, Download, Set as Default, Config
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #e8e8e8; border: 1px solid #444444; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #282828; border-color: #d4a843; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #1e1e1e; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { background: #282828; color: #888888; border-color: #333333; cursor: default; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: transparent; color: #cc4444; border: 1px solid #cc4444; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #cc4444; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-danger:active { background: #aa3333; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { background: #282828; color: #888888; border-color: #333333; cursor: default; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line text input — video path, project name, PDF name, URL
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0d0d0d; color: #e8e8e8; border: 1px solid #333333; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 12px; font-family: "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #d4a843; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #888888; }

components.name: Group Box
components.description: Settings section container — wraps grouped controls with a title
components.css: .ds-groupbox { background: #1e1e1e; border: 1px solid #333333; border-radius: 8px; padding: 20px 14px 14px; margin-top: 12px; font-family: "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: #e8e8e8; } .ds-groupbox legend { color: #d4a843; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; padding: 0 8px; margin-left: 6px; }

components.name: Tab Navigation
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: none; } .ds-tab { background: transparent; color: #888888; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #e8e8e8; } .ds-tab-active { color: #d4a843; border-bottom-color: #d4a843; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.css: .ds-progress { position: relative; background: #0d0d0d; border: 1px solid #333333; border-radius: 6px; height: 28px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { background: #d4a843; height: 100%; border-radius: 5px; transition: width 0.3s ease; } .ds-progress-label { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #e8e8e8; }

components.name: Seek Bar Handle
components.description: Dual-handle seek bar for video trimming
components.css: .ds-seekbar { position: relative; height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-seekbar-track { position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; height: 4px; background: #282828; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-seekbar-handle { position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 24px; height: 24px; margin-top: -12px; margin-left: -12px; background: #d4a843; border: 2px solid #161616; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seekbar-handle:hover { background: #e0b85a; }

donts: Don't introduce a second accent color. Warm Brass is the only accent.
Don't use drop shadows on resting surfaces — flat is the default.
Don't use decorative borders thicker than 2px or colored borders on card sides.
Don't add display or decorative fonts — Segoe UI carries everything.
Don't use gradient text, glass effects, or sparklines — the studio aesthetic is solid and tactile.
keyCharacteristics: Studio-dark ambient environment with tonal layering
Warm brass as the sole accent color — rare enough that it guides attention
Precision typography: Segoe UI with CJK fallbacks, clean 13px body
Controls recede; the score preview is the star
Flat surfaces at rest, subtle shadows on elevated containers (dialogs, popups, dropdowns)
Every element serves the task: no decoration without purpose
dos: Do use Warm Brass sparingly — it's a spotlight, not a wash.
Do let the score preview occupy the majority of vertical space.
Do use tonal surfaces for depth — stack #161616 → #1e1e1e → #282828.
Do align form labels to a consistent left column (115px).
narrative.overview: A modern recording studio control room translated to desktop software. The interface is dim and ambient — a dark lacquer background (#161616) like polished ebony, with warm brass controls (#d4a843) that glow against the darkness like studio hardware illuminated by a single lamp. Surfaces are layered tonal blacks (1e1e1e → 282828) rather than shadow-cast planes, giving the UI the solidity of machined equipment rather than the illusion of floating paper. This is a precision tool for a single focused task: extracting clean pages from a piano score video. The interface recedes so the score preview leads. Controls are deliberate, not decorative — every button, knob, and input serves the workflow. The warmth of brass accents provides orientation and hierarchy without competing with the content.

rules.body: Warm Brass is the only saturated color in the UI. It must never share the stage with another accent color. Every green or red signal must be clearly semantic (success/error), never decorative.
rules.name: The Single Accent Rule

rules.body: Warm Brass occupies ≤10% of any screen. Its job is to direct attention, not to decorate. If more than one element needs brass emphasis in the same view, space them apart or demote the lesser element to border-only.
rules.name: The Rarity Rule

rules.body: Body text is 13px everywhere. No size variation for body copy across contexts. Variation belongs to hierarchy steps, not to the base.
rules.name: The Single-Size Rule

rules.body: No decorative or display face is used. Segoe UI carries all typographic weight. A second font would break the studio-instrument precision.
rules.name: The No-Display-Font Rule

rules.body: Within each tab, spacing is uniform (setSpacing(8) on Extract, setSpacing(12) on Config). Major section changes are signaled by content boundaries, not by variable gaps. No ad-hoc spacers.
rules.name: The Uniform Gap Rule

rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to elevation change (modals, dropdowns, popups). A resting card or panel never casts a shadow.
rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule

mono.purpose: Log output, debug info, diagnostic text

body.purpose: All primary interface text — buttons, labels, fields, descriptions

display.purpose: Screen-level titles and headings — used sparingly

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs and popups that need clear separation
